a.name: Quote and nameplate
a.description: Each review on a pale quote panel closing on a steel nameplate; the middle plate is deepest steel and the short quote is set in the display face.
a.differs_from: Three compact quote panels each closed by a steel nameplate, the accent role shifting slot by slot; London's pick is one airy letter card with the photo at its left, the built rows are grids.

b.name: Margin quote
b.description: Open page, each review ruled off with a hanging display quote mark in the margin that swaps sides; the family's portrait in the far margin.
b.differs_from: No box at all: rules above and below, a hanging quote mark in the margin and a margin portrait on the top slot; London's pick is a raised letter card, the built rows are grids.

c.name: Three plates
c.description: Three bleed photos, each with a bone plate overlapping it and one review: the photo side alternates left, right, left down the page.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's one wall with one review under a heading becomes three plates, one per slot, the photo changing sides slot by slot. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
